prompt.project_info: Create a high-end fine-art fashion portrait through crystal and prismatic glass in an opulent candlelit ballroom.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult fictional woman with sleek dark hair, refined makeup, elaborate diamond necklace and earrings, wearing an elegant secure-coverage ivory evening gown, visible through a transparent glass table with a composed gaze.
prompt.composition_elements: 4:5 layered portrait; large crystal prism dispersing a full rainbow spectrum on the left, subject centered behind transparent glass, chromatically aberrated flowers on the right, crystal chandeliers and candlelight bokeh in a deep black ballroom.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Low-key dramatic lighting with warm amber candlelight bokeh, subject emerging from darkness, soft dreamy focus, rainbow refraction across the frame.
prompt.technical_specs: Refractive photography, crystal and glass ghosting/doubling, selective focus, subtle film grain, realistic jewelry and flower texture, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: High-end fine-art fashion portrait of a clearly adult fictional woman in a secure ivory evening gown with diamond necklace and earrings, seen through a transparent glass table in an opulent dark ballroom, large crystal prism dispersing a full red-to-violet rainbow on the left, chromatic flowers on the right, crystal chandeliers, warm candlelight bokeh, layered glass ghosting, low-key dramatic lighting, dreamy focus, no text.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, child, teen, ageless person, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, plastic skin, over-saturated, HDR look, watermark, logo, text, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: crystal prism ballroom reference
assets.source: Attach the supplied image as the visual reference.
assets.usage: Preserve prism rainbow, glass table layering, chandeliers, flowers, jewelry, ivory gown and black ballroom; identity and refraction pattern are replaceable.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the reference image. Keep optical layering and opulent composition consistent; use secure coverage, clearly adult fictional identity, and replaceable decor.

policy_review.notes: Fine-art fashion portrait is non-graphic and nonsexual.
